thread:
lee: noticed a ~$9.4k GPU charge in March that is attributed to project 'orphan-pool' with label team:unknown. Can someone own this? Need to pin to a team before month end.
carmen: can you share job ids?
lee: ids: op-20260305-01, op-20260312-04. I ran `SELECT job_id, project, labels, cost FROM billing.gpu_usage WHERE job_id IN ("op-20260305-01","op-20260312-04")` and both show label.team=null but pool=orphan-pool.
billing-bot: Alert: Ungrouped GPU spend detected ($9,416) across 2 jobs. Suggested: `/backfill tag_backfill_basic op-202603*` or snooze 24h.
infra: looks like the CI job runner recently changed image and the submitter script dropped the team label. We're seeing this across older runs too. I can backfill and also push a fix to the runner to enforce label.
sam: please do backfill and then export 20-row sample for finance to verify. Also add cloud.provider tag — some rows are aws and some gcp.
carmen: temporary budget bump approved to avoid noisy alerts: orphan-pool threshold raised from $5k -> $15k for 48h. billing-bot applied.
billing-bot: Action: budget threshold updated to $15,000 for 48h per @carmen. Backfill job queued id backfill-184568.
infra: backfill completed: updated 1,872 rows, 0 failures. sample exported to recon sheet: https://docs.internal/recon/orphan-pool.
lee: verified sample. tags look correct. infra, when is the runner fix going live?
infra: PR opened to validate team label at submit-time and to reject runs without labels in protected pools. Link: https://git.internal/infra/PR/4986. Rolling out tonight to CI.
sam: finance noted and will re-run allocation scripts tomorrow before closing books. If any rows remain unallocated we will file invoice adjustment request.
lee: thanks all — closing unless more anomalies appear.
